mentions.name: Wherewhen
mentions.description: Wherewhen is a travel planner that lets users fix specific times, such as a restaurant reservation, and automatically moves the rest of the itinerary around those fixed commitments.
mentions.problem: Nothing available had everything the author wanted in a travel planner.
mentions.source_excerpt: https://www.wherewhen.cc/, a travel planner, because nothing had everything I wanted. Wherewhen allows you to fix some times (eg a restaurant reservation) and moves everything else around that.
